name: What permits are required for kitchen cabinet installation in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for kitchen cabinet installation in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Daly City, permits for kitchen cabinet installation are typically not required if the work solely involves replacing existing cabinets in their original locations without altering plumbing, electrical, or structural elements. However, if the project includes reconfiguring the kitchen layout, moving plumbing lines, adding new electrical outlets, or making structural changes, then building permits will be necessary. As your general contractor, City Dweller, LLC will assess your specific project to determine permit requirements and handle all necessary applications.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Daly City, permits are usually not needed for simple cabinet replacement, but are required for layout changes, plumbing/electrical alterations, or structural modifications.
